name: Jac
caption: Your social status is not gonna set you free. Your self-worth will.

slides.text:
Your social status is not gonna set you free.

Straight up.

Your self-worth will.

We were taught that if you got the car, the title, the money,

people would respect you and you'd finally feel good about yourself.

Pretty much everybody bought it, right?

But you can see someone's real value without them saying a word.

How they carry themselves. How they stand. How they make decisions when nobody's clapping.

That's not status. That's WORTH.

Status, you gotta keep feeding it.

The next car. The next title. The next number.

Worth, you just gotta look inside and actually OWN it.

Nobody's coming to hand you your freedom.

Not a job. Not a title. Not a follower count.

It's inside you. It always was.

So stop asking how you look to them.

Start asking who you are when nobody's watching.

That's where you get back your time, your freedom, and your fucking peace.
